# Alamy

> Alamy is a global stock photography and media marketplace offering millions of images, AI training datasets, and licensing solutions for creators and enterprises.

Alamy connects photographers and content creators with buyers seeking high-quality stock imagery, editorial content, and ethically-sourced media for machine learning applications. The platform provides tools for contributors to monetize their work while offering customers access to diverse visual content across multiple formats and use cases.

## Key Topics

- Stock Photography
- Stock Images
- AI Training Data
- Image Licensing
- Content Creators

- Drone Photography

- Photography Education
- Image Monetization

## Core Products & Services

- [Contributor Program](https://www.alamy.com/contributor): Upload and monetize your photographs and footage. Capture, upload, and earn by submitting your creatives to maximize your income.
- [AI Training Media - Alamy Access Collection](https://www.alamy.com/ai-training-media): Fuel your AI models with ethically sourced images. Alamy's Access Collection provides curated datasets for machine learning and model training.
- [Live News Photos](https://www.alamy.com/news/newsresults.aspx): Access current editorial and sports stock photography. Browse live news feeds with up-to-date visual content from around the world.
- [Fresh Picks - Curated Collections](https://www.alamy.com/fresh-picks): Discover hand-picked stock photo collections and trending visual mood boards curated by industry experts.

## Learning & Community

- [Alamy Blog](https://www.alamy.com/blog): Stock photography trends, insights, and inspiration. Read photographer spotlights, photography education tips, and industry trends.

## Support & Resources

- [Help & FAQs](https://www.alamy.com/help): Comprehensive help center with FAQs for customers and contributors covering licensing, billing, and platform usage.
